items.text: TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut today vs. Saints after knee injury; expected earlier.
items.why: Cleared for debut; ETR/Levitan projecting IN despite Q.
items.implication: High-upside TE1 start; volume expected in debut.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, red-zone as primary TE.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs. Chiefs due to knee injury after earlier questionable to return.
items.why: Knee injury sustained; Rapoport confirmed ruled out.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup RBs elevated; avoid Achane entirely.
items.opportunity: Full backfield snaps/carries to remaining MIA RBs.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout looked good; true GTD earlier with team not counting on him.
items.why: Pregame workout on field in Brazil tested hamstring positively; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.implication: Startable but risky/limited; reverse prior OUT projections and Bateman/Andrews beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if limited; monitor snap share early.
items.conflict: ETR/Levitan had OUT in morning projections.

items.text: Jets WR AD Mitchell inactive vs Lions (finger); was GTD. Saw team-high 12 targets last week.
items.why: Finger injury; Fowler source expected inactive.
items.implication: Garrett Wilson clear WR1; depth chart shifts to Isaiah Williams etc.
items.opportunity: Wilson targets/routes up; TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide snaps per Levitan.

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren active (shoulder Q, expected); Dowdle out elevates him.
items.why: Expected and confirmed active; ETR/Levitan projecting IN.
items.implication: Lead back volume with Dowdle OUT; strong start.
items.opportunity: Carries, snaps, goal-line with Dowdle sidelined.

items.text: With Mitchell inactive, Jets WRs: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain; expect TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide snaps.
items.implication: Wilson massive volume; depth cheap options DFS/season.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets spike; Sadiq versatile usage.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, Q) expected to play and active vs Chargers; Levitan projecting limited.
items.why: Source expected to play; officially active with Keon Coleman.
items.implication: Startable but limited snaps possible; monitor usage.
items.opportunity: Targets if full; reverse limited projections if unrestricted.

items.text: ETR/Levitan have Zay Flowers OUT in projections (hamstring); possible play, late swap Bateman/Andrews DFS. Moore limited, Mitchell out assumptions.
items.why: Team not counting; no early info on Moore/Mitchell.
items.implication: Fade Flowers initially; pivot on news. Limited Moore.
items.opportunity: Bateman/Andrews if Flowers sits; reverse later ACTIVE.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: Flowers GTD (not counting), Spears hopeful; Expected: Warren/Pittman/Barkley/Smith/Bowers/Evans/Coker/Coleman. Q: Parkinson/Bagent. Projs: Flowers OUT, Moore limited, Mitchell out.
items.implication: Parse all for lineup locks; update on actives.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for any OUT; reverse on unexpected IN.
items.conflict: Later Flowers ACTIVE vs projs OUT.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring, 3-4 week injury; out for MNF, Bagent cleared protocol later.
items.why: Doctors timeline per sources with Rapoport; quick healer hope.
items.implication: Keenum/Bagent start MNF; fade Bears pass catchers short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming; Swift/Monangai run game focus.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins OUT second straight week (hamstring); decent chance return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Schultz elevated targets continue; stash Collins.
items.opportunity: Schultz 28% target share last week; Colts matchup TE-friendly.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot Q) expected to play and active vs Bengals.
items.why: Source expected; ETR listed expected to play.

items.text: Berry loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor rush D; feed him.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches, 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Berry hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
Berry loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% target share last week with Collins out (30% routes); IND 4th-most yds to TEs. 10 Facts confirms.
items.why: Collins absence drove share; matchup boosts.
items.opportunity: Targets, routes elevated; TE DVP favorable.

items.text: 10 Facts: After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps, out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but ranks Stevenson ahead still.
items.why: Post-fumble lead role sample; pass pro trust issue remains.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full takeover; monitor split.
